name: Strength
description: Increases attack damage by {amount}.

name: Dexterity
description: Increases Block gained from cards by {amount}.

name: Vigor
description: This creature's next Attack deals {amount} additional damage.

name: Artifact
description: Negates the next {amount} debuffs.

name: Plating
description: At the end of its turn, gain {amount} Block. Plating is reduced by 1 at the start of its turn.

name: Intangible
description: Reduce all damage taken and HP loss to 1 for {amount} turns.

name: Thorns
description: When hit by an attack, deal {amount} damage back.

name: Ritual
description: Gain {amount} Strength at the end of its turn.

name: Vulnerable
description: Receive 50% more damage from Attacks for {amount} turns.

name: Weak
description: Deal 25% less damage with Attacks for {amount} turns.

name: Frail
description: Gain 25% less Block from cards for {amount} turns.

name: Shrink
description: This creature's Attacks deal 30% less damage.

name: Constrict
description: While the Slithering Strangler is alive, at the end of your turn, take {amount} damage.

name: Tangled
description: Attacks cost {amount} additional Energy this turn.

name: Smoggy
description: You can only play 1 Skill per turn.

name: Ringing
description: You can only play 1 card this turn.

name: No Draw
description: You may not draw any more cards this turn.

name: No Energy Gain
description: You cannot gain additional Energy this turn.

name: Barricade
description: Block is not removed at the start of your turn.

name: Demon Form
description: At the start of your turn, gain {amount} Strength.

name: Feel No Pain
description: Whenever a card is Exhausted, gain {amount} Block.

name: Dark Embrace
description: Whenever a card is Exhausted, draw {amount} card(s).

name: Rupture
description: Whenever you lose HP on your turn, gain {amount} Strength.

name: Inferno
description: At the start of your turn, lose 1 HP. Whenever you lose HP on your turn, deal {amount} damage to ALL enemies.

name: Juggernaut
description: Whenever you gain Block, deal {amount} damage to a random enemy.

name: Cruelty
description: Vulnerable enemies take an additional {amount}% damage.

name: Crimson Mantle
description: At the start of your turn, lose HP and gain {amount} Block.

name: Crimson Mantle (HP loss)
description: Crimson Mantle loses {amount} HP at the start of your turn.

name: Pyre
description: Gain {amount} Energy at the start of each turn.

name: Corruption
description: Skills cost 0. Whenever you play a Skill, Exhaust it.

name: Rage
description: Whenever you play an Attack this turn, gain {amount} Block.

name: Vicious
description: Whenever you apply Vulnerable, draw {amount} card(s).

name: Flame Barrier
description: Whenever you are attacked this turn, deal {amount} damage back.

name: Unmovable
description: The first {amount} time(s) you gain Block from a card each turn, double the amount gained.

name: Aggression
description: At the start of your turn, put {amount} random Attack(s) from your Discard Pile into your Hand and Upgrade it for the rest of combat.

name: Hellraiser
description: Whenever you draw a card containing "Strike", it is played against a random enemy.

name: Stampede
description: At the end of your turn, {amount} random Attack(s) in your Hand are played against a random enemy.

name: Juggling
description: Add a copy of the third Attack you play each turn into your Hand.

name: Colossus
description: You receive 50% less damage from Vulnerable enemies.

name: One-Two Punch
description: Your next {amount} Attack(s) are played an extra time this turn.

name: Free Attack
description: Your next {amount} Attack(s) cost 0 Energy.

name: Temporary Strength
description: Lose {amount} Strength at the end of your turn.

name: Slippery
description: The next {amount} times this creature loses HP, it only loses 1 HP instead.

name: Hardened Shell
description: This creature cannot lose more than {amount} HP each turn.

name: Asleep
description: Awakens upon losing HP or after {amount} turns.

name: Minion
description: Minions abandon combat without their leader.

name: Illusion
description: When this dies, it revives next turn at full HP.

name: Infested
description: Upon dying, summons 4 Wrigglers.

name: Territorial
description: At the end of this creature's turn, it gains {amount} Strength.

name: Ravenous
description: When an enemy dies, Corpse Slug immediately eats it, becoming Stunned and gaining {amount} Strength.

name: Suck
description: Whenever this creature deals unblocked attack damage, it gains {amount} Strength.

name: Surprise
description: Something is off about this creature... (on death, a Sneaky Gremlin and a Fat Gremlin appear).

name: Skittish
description: The first time this creature is hit each turn, it gains {amount} Block.

name: Shriek
description: The first time this creature's HP reaches {amount} or below, it becomes Stunned.

name: Plow
description: The first time this creature's HP reaches {amount} or below, it becomes Stunned and loses all its Strength.

name: Steam Eruption
description: When killed, deals {amount} damage at the end of your next turn.

name: Slow
description: Whenever you play a card, this enemy receives 10% more damage from Attacks this turn.
